cases.name: 64 derived keys and labels default on

labels and sound switches leave notes and press state unchanged
Dock hide clears effects; hidden events are not replayed; multiple hide reasons respected

Dock warning cancel keeps value; confirmation changes demonstration preference only
volume slider spans 0–100 and keeps sound/visual/menu states independent
pause clears effects and suppresses new simulated downs
canceling hide demonstration does not leave a stale hidden reason
mouse preview routes through same strike and release path
900/1000/1100 geometry switches preserve visibility preference and held state

scope: Actual preview event handlers exercised in Node VM with DOM stubs and a controlled clock. Not browser interaction, rendering, accessibility or product integration.
